_about: A made scene: what Ling writes when the player wants a scene of their own. Same shape as an authored scene, in the player's language (zh or en, both if you can). Fields starting with _ are notes, dropped on save.

setup.zh: 暮色里的渡口，一条船，一个老船家。船家说，这船渡人，不渡心事。
setup.en: A ferry at dusk: one boat, one old boatman. He says the boat carries people, not their troubles.

text.en: He is looking at your sleeve.

exits.means: boards the boat, pays, or asks to cross

text.zh: 船离岸时，你觉得袖子轻了。
text.en: As the boat leaves the bank, your sleeve feels lighter.

exits.means: asks the boatman a question, talks with him

text.zh: 他数了三个名字，第三个没说完。
text.en: He counts three names and stops before the third.

exits.means: gives or offers him the lingzhi or an herb

refuse.en: You have no lingzhi on you.

text.zh: 他把灵芝别在船头，像别一盏灯。
text.en: He pins the lingzhi to the prow like a lamp.

_rules: id starts with made-; chapter is made.
place, setup and every text are {zh, en} — the player's language at least.
1 to 4 exits; each has means (plain words) and exactly one of next (another made scene id), stay (true) or ends ("made", back to the spine).
buttons name exits that have a label; at most 3.

grant only from the branch table (xw up to 20, ls up to 5), progress and wealth and nothing else — no item, cast, card or art; each exit pays once; needs/take only items in the bag list Look gives; a need has a refuse line.
cast and show only creatures with a card (Look's creatures) and yinyue; no set, value, key, game or offers.
The world's heritage only; never the spine, a cauldron, Yinyue's memory or a realm.
